segments.text: Shipping twenty features in parallel isn't about working overtime. Hand the follow-ups to a Leader Agent, and keep your focus on decisions.
What does running five tasks at once feel like? One needs confirmation, another throws an error. Jumping back and forth splits your attention five ways.
The problem isn't the workload. It's you. You became the bottleneck in the loop. Confirm, reply, review — every single task is waiting on you.
Take yourself out of the loop. Hand it to a Leader Agent. It dispatches, it follows up — one entry point managing twenty tasks.
Drop the tasks to the Leader Agent. No manual splitting, no manual dispatch. One prompt sets twenty tasks in motion.
On the right, a live board card appears. Title, slots, and status at a glance. Each card is an active task, backed by multiple worker agent sessions running in parallel.
Stop chasing agents one by one. Just ask: give me a status report. Twenty tasks, summarized in one reply.
Throughput jumps immediately. Not because you type faster, but because your focus stays intact. You make the calls; the Leader Agent drives the work.
To be real with you: I finally stopped jumping between sessions. The trade-off is just as clear — token spend scales right up with it.
One person, twenty parallel tasks. That's Leader Agent. Install dsh-leader-agent in DeepSeek Harness, and save your attention for what matters.
One last question: what multi-agent orchestration tools are you using today? Share your workflow with us.
